newsitem.title: USA: ITT Automotive to build N. Carolina plant.
newsitem.headline: ITT Automotive to build N. Carolina plant.

text.p: ITT Automotive, a subsidiary of ITT Industries Inc., said Thursday it will build a new 200,000-square-foot, $65 million brake manufacturing plant in Henderson County, North Carolina.

The new plant in the western part of the state will manufacture brake system components such as brake calipers and complete corner modules. It is expected to employ approximately 200 people when in full operation, ITT said.
Pilot production is planned to start in the summer of 1997, with full production expected by the spring of 1998.
The new facility will be ITT Automotive's third plant in North Carolina. It currently operates two plants in Asheville and Morganton, N.C., that employ more than 1,550 people.

"This new plant will give our Brake & Chassis Systems Group added capacity to provide faster and better service to our OEM customers," ITT Automotive President and Chief Executive Officer Timothy Leuliette said in a statement. "It is further evidence of our investment in the future as we move toward our goal of becoming an integral part of the system team of our customers."
